title: Trust resolver conflicts widen authority by registration order
claim: When two registered project-trust resolvers conflict, placing a Trust vote before a Deny vote produces Trusted and prevents the Deny resolver from running, so effective authority can broaden solely from registration order.

evidence.detail: resolve_trust iterates the public registry in insertion order and returns immediately on the first decided vote.
The explicit embedder test registers Trust then Deny, labels Deny shadowed, and asserts Trusted with only the first resolver invoked.
A second test requires first-vote short-circuit behavior and proves every later resolver is skipped.
